_comment: Workload -> environment map for SALM-model. Mirrors the SpeechAudioLM convention: one env per dependency stack, named <purpose>-<backbone>-<python>. Envs live on scratch to keep multi-GB torch installs off the home quota.

salm-train-audioldm.purpose: AudioLDM S2A training, precompute, and generation

external_environments._comment: Owned by the SpeechAudioLM repo. Reused read-only for metrics after training runs; do not rebuild from here.

eval-audioldm-fad-is.purpose: FAD + Inception Score over generated audio directories

eval-metrics-shared.purpose: shared metric stack (asr_wer, dwer, utmos, dnsmos, clapsim, ...)
